paper.title_en: Dissecting the nanohertz gravitational wave sky: Frequency-correlated anisotropy induced by eccentric supermassive black hole binaries
paper.abstract_en: Revealing the nature of the nanohertz gravitational wave (GW) signal recently reported by pulsar timing array (PTA) collaborations around the world is the next goal of low-frequency GW astronomy. The signal likely originates from the incoherent superposition of GWs emitted by a cosmological population of supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs). These binaries can be highly eccentric and/or strongly coupled to their nuclear environment, resulting in an attenuation of the overall GW signal at low frequencies. In this paper, we propose to use the correlation properties of the distributed GW power in the sky across the frequency spectrum as a smoking gun for eccentric SMBHBs, thus allowing us to break the spectral degeneracy between eccentricity and environmental effect. The simple underlying idea is that, contrary to circular binaries, eccentric ones emit a broadband spectrum thus resulting in similar sky maps at different frequencies. We first demonstrate the applicability of this simple concept on sky maps constructed directly from the theoretical sky distribution of the gravitational wave background (GWB) power induced by realistic populations of SMBHBs. We then demonstrate the viability of this analysis on simulated square kilometer array (SKA) like PTA data. By statistically comparing sky maps reconstructed from hundreds of injected circular and highly eccentric SMBHB populations, we find that eccentricity can be detected at $3σ$ in more than $50\%$ of cases.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文聚焦脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）探测的纳赫兹引力波背景，提出利用天空图中引力波功率随频率的相关性各向异性来区分偏心超大质量黑洞双星与环境效应造成的谱简并，并在类SKA的模拟PTA数据上验证了统计可探测性，与PTA方向高度相关且方法具体、结果有量化指标，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 剖析纳赫兹引力波天空：偏心超大质量黑洞双星引起的频率相关各向异性
decision.abstract_zh: 揭示世界各地脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）合作组最近报告的纳赫兹引力波（GW）信号的本质，是低频引力波天文学的下一个目标。该信号很可能源于宇宙学种群中超大质量黑洞双星（SMBHB）所发射引力波的非相干叠加。这些双星可能具有高偏心率，和/或与其核区环境强烈耦合，从而导致整体引力波信号在低频处被衰减。在本文中，我们提出利用天空中分布的引力波功率在频谱上的相关性质，作为偏心SMBHB的“确凿证据”，从而使我们能够打破偏心率与环境效应之间的谱简并。其简单的基本思想是：与圆轨道双星相反，偏心双星发射宽带谱，因而在不同频率下产生相似的天空图。我们首先在直接由真实SMBHB种群所诱导的引力波背景（GWB）功率的理论天空分布构建的天空图上，证明了这一简单概念的适用性。随后，我们在模拟的平方千米阵（SKA）类PTA数据上证明了该分析的可行性。通过统计比较从数百个注入的圆轨道和高偏心率SMBHB种群重建的天空图，我们发现，在超过$50\%$的情形中可以在$3\sigma$水平上探测到偏心率。
